# Concurrent-operations pass (FIDESLIB_CONCURRENT_OPS=1): tests that fail in every
# full run, each section with its reason. The check skips them. A pull request that
# fixes one deletes its line. One gtest filter pattern per line.

# The fifth parameter set (FLEXIBLEAUTOEXT) under concurrent operations:
# LanesMatchSerial/4 returns a ciphertext on one lane whose every coefficient
# differs from the serial run, and SharedOperandsMatchSerial/4 stops the whole
# process with a CUDA illegal memory access during a 32768-slot bootstrap, which
# hides every test after it.
ConcurrencyTests/ConcurrentOpsTest.*/4

# Bootstrap under concurrent operations with the FIXEDMANUAL parameter sets at
# dnum >= 2: one lane returns a ciphertext whose every coefficient differs from
# the serial run. In these sets the serial reference's own decode also fails at
# times ("approximation error is too high").
ConcurrencyTests/ConcurrentOpsTest.BootstrapLanesMatchSerial/3
ConcurrencyTests/ConcurrentOpsTest.BootstrapLanesMatchSerial/5
ConcurrencyTests/ConcurrentOpsTest.BootstrapLanesMatchSerial/7
